payload.title: Tracing Transformations
payload.summary: This Jupyter notebook, authored by Julien Emile-Geay, demonstrates how to track data transformations using the `keep_log` parameter in the Pyleoclim library. It focuses on ensuring reproducibility by logging each step of data manipulation, using a dataset of benthic δ18O records. The notebook includes loading, slicing, detrending, interpolating, and standardizing the dataset, with a focus on maintaining a log of these transformations. The final output is a visual representation of the data transformations applied.
goals: Learn how to use the `keep_log` parameter to track transformations in timeseries data.

section_blurbs.blurb: The notebook introduces the concept of tracking data transformations to ensure reproducibility. It uses the Pyleoclim library to load and manipulate the LR04 dataset, demonstrating how to log each transformation step.
section_blurbs.heading: Tracing Transformations

inputs: LR04 dataset of benthic δ18O records
outputs: Plots of the original and transformed data
